ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Fixes Stage 2's PR-identity resolver (pr-review-run.yml + the shipped claude-review-run.yml.template) so it also resolves a fork PR's head SHA, which commits/{sha}/pulls silently never did. Trust boundary unchanged: identity still comes solely from the trusted workflow_run event (REPO, HEAD_SHA), never from stage 1's artifact or any PR-controlled input; the exactly-one-match ambiguity guard is untouched. No new secret, no new permission, no new trust source.
